nodeIPVersionHelp: Applies to normal traffic and latency checks. Single-family modes resolve destination hostnames only in that family and reject IP addresses from the other family. Automatic keeps the existing dual-stack behavior.
nodeLatencyURLHelp: Overrides this node's HTTP target for TCP Ping. Leave blank to use the global target. The URL must be reachable through this node.
nodeLatencyInsecureSkipVerifyHelp: Only applies to this node's custom HTTPS latency URL. Keep off unless its certificate cannot be trusted.
newConnectionsUseTheChangesAfterActivati: New connections use the changes after activation completes.

enterADomainOrIpAddressBelowToSeeWhichRu: Enter a domain or IP address below to see which rule and outbound node would be selected.

backupsIncludeAllListsRulesAndNodeConfig: Backups include all lists, rules, and node configurations.
builtWithLoveAndOpenSourceSoftware: Built with love and open-source software.
collectionPausesInTheBackgroundOrWhenPau: Collection pauses in the background or when paused. Events during that time are not collected; retained logs stay available.
closingANodeHereWillForceAReconnectionIf: Closing a node here will force a reconnection if the rule still requires it.
createANodeOrImportJsonToGetStarted: Create a node or import JSON to get started.
shareSelectedNodesAsPublishConfigs: Share selected nodes as publish configs
usersStillUsedByAnotherNodeOrSubscriptio: Users still used by another node or subscription will be kept.
noTrafficRecordedInThisRange: No traffic recorded in this range.
thisInboundDoesNotBindANetworkListener: This inbound does not bind a network listener.
authenticationIsManagedCentrallyInUserMa: Authentication is managed centrally in User Management. This inbound automatically accepts enabled inbound users.
runtimeStatusIsNotAvailableYet: Runtime status is not available yet.
noStructuredEditorForThisProtocolYet: No structured editor for this protocol yet.
globalProtectTLSHelp: Use a CA certificate for self-signed gateways when possible. Insecure Skip Verify disables certificate and hostname checks.
globalProtectGatewayInfoHelp: Loads the last getconfig response from an active connection. This only reads cached information and does not connect or sign in.
globalProtectGatewayInfoUnavailable: No active GlobalProtect connection information is available. Connect this node first; this request will not start a connection.
globalProtectLocalNetworkPolicy: No direct access to local network
theProfileIsPassedDirectlyToOpenvpnCoreC: The profile is passed directly to OpenVPN Core. Certificate-based/autologin profiles do not require username or password. UDP transport profiles are currently supported.
inboundAuthenticationUsesAllEnabledInbou: Inbound authentication uses all enabled inbound users. Outbound protocols select a local user.
autoFakeIpRouteDescription: Merge the active FakeIP IPv4 and IPv6 ranges with your routes and update them when the ranges change. Only available address families are added.
hysteria2BandwidthHelp: 0 uses automatic congestion control (BBR). Nonzero values must be at least 65536 bytes/s. Upload/download are from this endpoint’s perspective.
ignoreClientBandwidth: Ignore client bandwidth (use automatic congestion control)
hysteria2ServerHelp: Hysteria 2 uses UDP-only and one TLS certificate configuration. For TLS-auto, set Server Names to the SNI clients will use. The CA is generated on save; copy its public certificate to the client’s CA Certificate field.
hysteria2AddressHopHelp: Add UDP relay addresses; Host is also included. With this list set, domains contribute all returned A/AAAA IPs to the hopping pool. Each entry accepts a port list or range. All IPs must forward to the same Hysteria 2 server and UDP listener. Set Server Names to the final server’s certificate name. DNS refreshes on reconnection; unreachable relays are not automatically detected.
hysteria2HopClientHelp: To enable hopping, use a port list or range in Host, e.g. server.example:443,20000-50000. All intervals at 0 use 30 seconds. Set either a fixed interval or both minimum/maximum intervals; the minimum is 5 seconds. Server forwarding and firewall access must cover every listed port.
hysteria2HopServerHelp: Requires Linux and root or CAP_NET_ADMIN because it modifies kernel nftables rules to forward multiple UDP ports to one listener. Allow the range in your firewall; leave empty for external forwarding.
softEtherSecretHelp: The private key is stored in node settings. Protect exports and backups.
softEtherAddressHelp: Leave IPv4 empty for DHCP. For static IPv4 or IPv6 provide both address and router.
softEtherUDPAccelerationHelp: Requires direct UDP connectivity; unavailable through a chained proxy.
softEtherSecurityHelp: Verify the server certificate whenever possible. Disabling verification exposes VPN credentials.
globalProtectESPHelp: Try the encrypted UDP tunnel first. Fall back to SSL if the gateway or upstream proxy cannot carry ESP.
openVPNAuthHelp: Use a client certificate and key, username/password, or both as required by the server. Leave both client PEM fields empty for password-only authentication.
openVPNSecretHelp: Private keys and passwords are saved with this node. Protect node exports and backups.
openVPNProtectionHelp: Match the server profile. tls-auth and tls-crypt are mutually exclusive; tls-auth also requires the matching key direction and HMAC digest.
openVPNCipherHelp: Offer at least one AEAD cipher supported by the server. CBC, compression, TAP and tls-crypt-v2 are not supported.
openVPNMTUHelp: MTU 0 uses the negotiated value; overrides must be 576–1500 (at least 1280 for IPv6). Rekey interval 0 uses 3600 seconds. Successful rekeys preserve existing connections.
openVPNReconnectHelp: Recreate the tunnel after a failure. Existing application connections must reconnect after the full session is recreated.
openVPNTLSHelp: Certificate-chain and server-auth verification is enabled by default. System trust also verifies the gateway hostname. With a custom CA, server name optionally adds hostname verification; with system trust, it overrides the gateway name. Disable verification only when required for a trusted server.
openVPNInfoHelp: Read the active cached tunnel without starting a connection. Pushed DNS and routes are informational; configure yuhaiin DNS and routing separately.
openVPNInfoUnavailable: No active OpenVPN information is available. Connect this node first; this request does not start a connection.
l2tpHelp: L2TPv2 over UDP with PPP. This mode does not use IPsec or encrypt the data channel.
l2tpv3Help: Ethernet pseudowire over UDP. Configure an IPv4 or IPv6 prefix and an optional router on the remote Ethernet network.
l2tpIPv6Help: IPv6CP negotiates link-local addresses. Enter a server-configured IPv6 prefix for routed IPv6 traffic; MTU must be at least 1280.
l2tpStaticHelp: Use prearranged session IDs and cookies without control negotiation. Both peers must agree on cookies, sublayer and UDP ports.
l2tpCookieHelp: Leave empty, or enter 8 or 16 hex digits. Receive cookie must match what the peer transmits; transmit cookie must match what the peer expects.
l2tpInfoUnavailable: No active L2TP connection information is available.
profilerEmpty: Capture a profile to view its flame graph.
profilerRunningHint: You can view other saved profiles while capture runs.
profilerCpuDescription: Find CPU hotspots and expensive call paths.
profilerMutexDescription: Find lock contention and wait time.
updateCompleted: Update completed. The new version is running.
updateWaitingForRestart: Waiting for the service to restart and verifying the installed version…
updateRecoveryTimeout: The new version could not be verified yet. Check the service and retry.
profilerConnectionError: Cannot reach the yuhaiin backend. Check the API address, backend version, browser network restrictions and CORS settings.
profilerGraphHint: Select a node to focus on its function, then apply filters.
tunStackExperimentalWarning: Experimental. The existing stack remains the default. Linux offload is unavailable; macOS, Windows and mobile runtime support is not yet validated.
tunStackDriverHint: Lightweight currently requires the channel driver; selecting it switches the driver to channel.
tunCongestionControlHint: CUBIC + HyStart++ is the default. Reno also uses HyStart++; BBR uses v3 with its own startup. This setting applies to new TCP connections in this TUN stack.
tunDarwinBatchDescription: Off by default. Saving restarts this TUN. Unsupported macOS devices automatically use single-packet I/O.
tunDarwinPendingHint: The actual queue may be smaller due to MTU and system buffer limits.
wgNoSystemTun: WireGuard serves UDP clients through the in-memory lightweight stack; no system TUN, kernel routes or root privileges are needed.
wgNoExtraTransports: WireGuard manages its own encrypted UDP transport. Additional transports are not supported.
wgAddressesHint: For example: 10.66.0.1/24 and fd66::1/64. Each client must receive a unique host address.
wgSecurityHint: Set only a unique /32 or /128 client address per peer on the server. The client can use 0.0.0.0/0 as its AllowedIPs. Protect private keys and backups.
sshTCPOnlyHelp: SSH forwards TCP only. UDP traffic needs a separate outbound. Verify the server's host key independently.
